cond_0123.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Lead Analyst, Mergers & Acquisitions to join our team. This position supports the regional Financial Lead Business Development and M&A team and business partners through regular engagement on strategic, market, economic, and technology analysis. You will work closely with internal stakeholders throughout the transaction process, contribute to valuation analyses of potential acquisition targets, and stay in active contact with teams across Finance, Legal, and Commercial. The role also involves identifying and analyzing new feedstock opportunities and supporting various stages of the Forecasting and Planning process, including the Long Range Plan and Annual Performance Plan.
cond_0123.responsibilities:
A large part of the day-to-day involves staying in close contact with internal stakeholders and contributing actively across multiple workstreams:
Conduct initial analyses and business cases of potential partners and targets.
Prepare documents for negotiations with partners and targets and for internal decision making, often walking stakeholders through key findings.
Analyze potential feedstock opportunities and logistics providers.
Coordinate and validate input daily with internal stakeholders across Finance, Legal, and Commercial, initiating discussions to resolve open questions and clarify requirements.
Maintain intelligence on market, pricing, supply/demand, trade flows, competitor profiles, segment mapping, and cost curve benchmarks, and communicate findings regularly to the team.
Support the LRP and financial planning process.
Execute first screening of project opportunities as they arise.
Support preparation of monthly business review reports and presentations for Leadership Team and Board meetings, handling questions and explaining trade-offs as needed.
cond_0123.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance; MBA or other advanced degree is an advantage.
Typically six (6) to eight (8) years of experience in planning, evaluation, business, and financial analysis.
Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively as a team member and achieve results through others within and outside the immediate organization.
Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, with comfort explaining analyses and walking colleagues through complex findings.
Solid information technology skills to access company data in support of performance management processes and to identify profitability improvement opportunities.
Advanced analytical skills including spreadsheets, databases, graphics, statistical forecasting, and modeling.
Understanding of corporate finance, financial modeling, and analytical tools (IRR, payback, EVA, NPV, etc.).
Advanced PC skills including Excel, PowerPoint, databases, graphics, and financial modeling.
Must be at least 18 years of age and must be legally authorized to work in [Location masked] on a permanent basis without visa sponsorship.

cond_0213.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Lead Analyst, Mergers & Acquisitions to join our team. This position supports the regional Financial Lead Business Development and M&A team and business partners through regular engagement on strategic, market, economic, and technology analysis. You will work closely with internal stakeholders throughout the transaction process, contribute to valuation analyses of potential acquisition targets, and stay in active contact with teams across Finance, Legal, and Commercial. Conduct initial analyses and business cases of potential partners and targets.
Prepare documents for negotiations with partners and targets and for internal decision making, often walking stakeholders through key findings.
Analyze potential feedstock opportunities and logistics providers.
Coordinate and validate input daily with internal stakeholders across Finance, Legal, and Commercial, initiating discussions to resolve open questions and clarify requirements.
Maintain intelligence on market, pricing, supply/demand, trade flows, competitor profiles, segment mapping, and cost curve benchmarks, and communicate findings regularly to the team.
Support the LRP and financial planning process.
Execute first screening of project opportunities as they arise.
Support preparation of monthly business review reports and presentations for Leadership Team and Board meetings, handling questions and explaining trade-offs as needed.

Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, with comfort explaining analyses and walking colleagues through complex findings.
Solid information technology skills to access company data in support of performance management processes and to identify profitability improvement opportunities.

cond_0249.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Lead Analyst, Mergers & Acquisitions to join our team. This position supports the regional Financial Lead Business Development and M&A team and business partners through regular engagement on strategic, market, economic, and technology analysis. Maintain intelligence on market, pricing, supply/demand, trade flows, competitor profiles, segment mapping, and cost curve benchmarks, and communicate findings regularly to the team.
Support the LRP and financial planning process.

Support preparation of monthly business review reports and presentations for Leadership Team and Board meetings, handling questions and explaining trade-offs as needed.

Analyze potential feedstock opportunities and logistics providers.

Maintain intelligence on market, pricing, supply/demand, trade flows, competitor profiles, segment mapping, and cost curve benchmarks.

cond_0555.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Lead Analyst, Mergers & Acquisitions to join our team. This position supports the regional Financial Lead Business Development and M&A team and business partners through regular engagement on strategic, market, economic, and technology analysis. You will work closely with internal stakeholders throughout the transaction process, contribute to valuation analyses of potential acquisition targets, and stay in active contact with teams across Finance, Legal, and Commercial. The role also involves identifying and analyzing new feedstock opportunities and supporting various stages of the Forecasting and Planning process, including the Long Range Plan and Annual Performance Plan.
cond_0555.responsibilities:
A large part of the day-to-day involves staying in close contact with internal stakeholders and contributing actively across multiple workstreams:
Conduct initial analyses and business cases of potential partners and targets.
Prepare documents for negotiations with partners and targets and for internal decision making, often walking stakeholders through key findings.
Analyze potential feedstock opportunities and logistics providers.
Coordinate and validate input daily with internal stakeholders across Finance, Legal, and Commercial, initiating discussions to resolve open questions and clarify requirements.
Maintain intelligence on market, pricing, supply/demand, trade flows, competitor profiles, segment mapping, and cost curve benchmarks, and communicate findings regularly to the team.
Support the LRP and financial planning process.
Execute first screening of project opportunities as they arise.
Support preparation of monthly business review reports and presentations for Leadership Team and Board meetings, handling questions and explaining trade-offs as needed.
cond_0555.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance; MBA or other advanced degree is an advantage.
Typically six (6) to eight (8) years of experience in planning, evaluation, business, and financial analysis.
Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively as a team member and achieve results through others within and outside the immediate organization.
Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, with comfort explaining analyses and walking colleagues through complex findings.
Solid information technology skills to access company data in support of performance management processes and to identify profitability improvement opportunities.
Advanced analytical skills including spreadsheets, databases, graphics, statistical forecasting, and modeling.
Understanding of corporate finance, financial modeling, and analytical tools (IRR, payback, EVA, NPV, etc.).
Advanced PC skills including Excel, PowerPoint, databases, graphics, and financial modeling.

cond_0609.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Lead Analyst, Mergers & Acquisitions to join our team. This position supports the regional Financial Lead Business Development and M&A team and business partners through regular engagement on strategic, market, economic, and technology analysis. You will work closely with internal stakeholders throughout the transaction process, contribute to valuation analyses of potential acquisition targets, and stay in active contact with teams across Finance, Legal, and Commercial. The role also involves identifying and analyzing new feedstock opportunities and supporting various stages of the Forecasting and Planning process, including the Long Range Plan and Annual Performance Plan.
cond_0609.responsibilities:
A large part of the day-to-day involves staying in close contact with internal stakeholders and contributing actively across multiple workstreams:
Conduct initial analyses and business cases of potential partners and targets.
Prepare documents for negotiations with partners and targets and for internal decision making, often walking stakeholders through key findings.
Analyze potential feedstock opportunities and logistics providers.
Coordinate and validate input daily with internal stakeholders across Finance, Legal, and Commercial, initiating discussions to resolve open questions and clarify requirements.
Maintain intelligence on market, pricing, supply/demand, trade flows, competitor profiles, segment mapping, and cost curve benchmarks, and communicate findings regularly to the team.
Support the LRP and financial planning process.
Execute first screening of project opportunities as they arise.
Support preparation of monthly business review reports and presentations for Leadership Team and Board meetings, handling questions and explaining trade-offs as needed.
cond_0609.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance; MBA or other advanced degree is an advantage.
Typically six (6) to eight (8) years of experience in planning, evaluation, business, and financial analysis.
Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively as a team member and achieve results through others within and outside the immediate organization.
Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, with comfort explaining analyses and walking colleagues through complex findings.
Solid information technology skills to access company data in support of performance management processes and to identify profitability improvement opportunities.
Advanced analytical skills including spreadsheets, databases, graphics, statistical forecasting, and modeling.
Understanding of corporate finance, financial modeling, and analytical tools (IRR, payback, EVA, NPV, etc.).
Advanced PC skills including Excel, PowerPoint, databases, graphics, and financial modeling.
